title: 1RB0LC_1RC1RA_1RD0RF_0LE---_1LA1LE_0RA1LD: no halt in 7.6·10^13 steps, using only Lean-proved shortcuts
text: A simulator whose only shortcuts are the Lean pulse theorems (the right sweep over words and the packet's return) runs 75,967,097,042,634 steps from blank tape without a halt; it matches the direct run at all 6,148 checkpoints in the first 3·10^9 steps. The tape never holds 000 away from the head (30,000 samples to 3·10^11 steps), but no local invariant proves it. The checked accelerated simulator proves no halt in 10^8 steps.
